events.did: Watched a lecture on covalent bonding, then paused it, scribbled down her timestamp and reset the student's progress to erase her tracks
events.quote_anchor: Syd clicked out of the lecture, scribbled down her timestamp, and reset the student’s progress, erasing her tracks like steps in snow

events.did: Swerved on instinct and toppled off her bike in the woods when a gun went off too close
events.quote_anchor: and she swerved on instinct, nearly hitting a tree. Syd half leapt, half toppled off the bike

events.did: Crouched and slipped the knife out of her boot, refusing to go down without a fight
events.quote_anchor: Slowly she crouched, and slipped the knife out of her boot, fingers flexing on the shortened grip. She wasn’t going down without a fight.

events.did: Found a stag dead with buckshot in its side, leaned her bike against a tree and knelt beside it
events.quote_anchor: Sydney leaned the bike against a tree and put the knife back in her boot as she shuffled closer.

events.did: Caught hold of the thread of the stag's life and pulled, dragging the beast back
events.quote_anchor: She reached, icy cold skating beneath her skin as she caught hold of the thread, teeth chattering as she pulled, dragging the beast back from wherever it had been.

events.did: Bolted through the trees when a branch snapped beneath a heavy boot, leaving Syd alone with the threat
events.quote_anchor: Just then, a branch snapped beneath a heavy boot, and by the time the sound ricocheted, the stag was already bolting through the trees, leaving Syd alone with the threat.

events.did: Caught the first hunter's shotgun muzzle and pulled the weapon down, saying they nearly shot her
events.quote_anchor: “Jesus,” said a second man, catching the first hunter’s muzzle and pulling the weapon down, away. “We nearly shot you.”

events.did: Pedaled toward the cabin without slowing, hearing the shotgun blast and feeling the thread crumble back to ashes
events.quote_anchor: Syd grabbed the bike and forced her legs to pedal toward the cabin. Didn’t slow, even when she heard the shotgun blast

relations.did: Has to beat Mitch home; her watch's second alarm warned her to hurry
relations.quote_anchor: As the men stalked past her, the second alarm chimed on her watch, warning her to hurry, or she wouldn’t beat Mitch home.

relations.did: Fears EON agents springing out between the trees and closing in on her
relations.quote_anchor: she held her breath, and scanned the forest, waiting for the danger to reveal itself, for EON agents to spring out between the trees

relations.did: Is the example Sydney gives of people being complicated because they are fueled by their own wants and needs
relations.quote_anchor: People were more complicated, fueled by their own wants and needs (see: Victor), but animals sensed the thread that ran between them now

relations.did: Gave Sydney a hot cocoa at the library and warned her not to drink it over the keyboard
relations.quote_anchor: A hot cocoa cooled at her elbow—courtesy of Martha, who warned her not to drink it over the keyboard

numbers.quote_anchor: The class was only half done, but Syd was secretly grateful when her watch gave a warning chime

numbers.did: had three alarms set and the first one chimed
numbers.quote_anchor: when her watch gave a warning chime (the first of three she’d set). Her vision was starting to blur.

numbers.did: was sailing through the woods five minutes after setting the bike upright
numbers.quote_anchor: Her bike groaned a little as she dragged it upright, but five minutes later, she was sailing through the woods.

numbers.did: chimed its second alarm, warning her to hurry
numbers.quote_anchor: As the men stalked past her, the second alarm chimed on her watch, warning her to hurry, or she wouldn’t beat Mitch home.
